## Overview

`ifc-schema` — the IFC schema **as data**, not as 2,500 generated structs.

## Features

| Feature | Default | Enables |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `artifact` |  | `dep:bincode`, `dep:thiserror` |
| `express` |  | `dep:openbim-step` |
| `generation` |  | `express`, `ifc2x3`, `ifc4`, `ifc4x1`, `ifc4x2`, `ifc4x3` |
| `ifc2x3` | yes | `artifact` |
| `ifc4` | yes | `artifact` |
| `ifc4x1` | yes | `artifact` |
| `ifc4x2` | yes | `artifact` |
| `ifc4x3` | yes | `artifact` |
